name: Conversion Funnel
when_to_pick: Show how a population shrinks across the ordered stages of a journey — visitors -> sign-ups -> funded accounts -> active traders, signal-views -> broker clicks -> registrations -> deposits, or an IB recruitment funnel (leads -> calls -> sign-ups -> producing sub-IBs). Each stage is a proportional bar (width = its share of the top stage) with the count and the percent of the entry that survives to it, so the drop-off between steps is obvious. Pick this when the STORY is attrition through a sequence; for a non-shrinking ordered process use how_it_works_steps, and for parts of one whole use chart_doughnut.

unit.description: Optional unit/suffix shown after each value, e.g. 'leads', 'users', '$'.

stages.description: Ordered stages from widest (top, the entry population) to narrowest. The FIRST stage should be the largest — every bar is sized relative to it.

value.description: Count reaching this stage. The first stage is treated as 100%.

note.description: Optional short annotation for the stage.

caption.description: Optional one-line takeaway under the funnel.
